paragraphs.text: you are the moon. it's time to herd some turtles.

this is a game i made in what feels like two weekends, but was probably three. it is based on a game pitch that i made with some friends at an igda 'pitch jam'- basically practicing quick ideation and a quick sell. i don't think anyone at this event had any plans to materialize their pitch, but one day i got bored and made turtle herdle without telling any of my original pitchmates. they thought it was pretty cool.

i have a real soft spot for this game, it's so simple and small but it's also very polished and feels really coherent. i made it all in p5.js which i will never do again because something devastating happens to the audio if you play it for too long- but otherwise it runs like a dream. i think this is a fun and clever puzzle game and the implementation is really elegant.
